An unmatched [ in a link label is escaped so the link survives

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<a href=\"S\">[A;B)</a>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
